observation: Captured greeble_pipes.glb isolated (chase/close/inspect, all ok=true, 46/660/1810 KB) and in assembled context on a modular GLTFKit hull fitted with mod_mining_laser_s. mining is always a verb module (moduleGrantsVerb), so it survives both the integrated-hardpoints verb filter and the outfit-budget filter; scene probe confirmed authoredSlots.greeble=[hatches, antennas, pipes, armor_plates] on assembled-modular-fitted (frames 49/303/1628 KB, ok=true) with pipes mounted at SOCKET_Mining_Front. On the whole Kestrel the same fit does NOT draw pipes: authoredHullJobs detects the Forge hull already models mining hardware and skips the duplicate socket mount — expected production behavior, documented for the orchestrator. The four long pipes with bright end rings read as industrial hardware on the modular hull; signal/attachment role verified in assembly.
decision: Capture evidence produced for isolated + assembled verification; final visual acceptance belongs to the orchestrator.
next: Orchestrator visual acceptance of the assembled-modular-fitted close/inspect frames. Note pipes never appear on production whole ships that model their own mining hardware (Kestrel) — only on modular hulls or hulls without authored mining jobs.
